thread.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene Savages Trump Official as a 'Coward'
thread.title_full: Marjorie Taylor Greene Savages Trump Official as a 'Coward'

author: Prove Me Wrong
text:
Don’t buy into this. Marge can’t have it both ways. She’s a grifter using Epstein’s victims as her play. Before jumping on me, keep reading.
She’s one of the biggest protectors of Matt Gaetz, who has been investigated for relations with underage women and drugs. The DOJ investigated him for alleged sex trafficking of a 17-year-old and drug use tied to his associate Joel Greenberg. That investigation did not result in charges against Gaetz, but it remains part of his public record and reputation. Greene has publicly defended Gaetz throughout.
And now she’s on Eric Bolling’s podcast, the same Eric Bolling who was ousted from Fox News in 2017 after allegations of sexual harassment.
The truth is, Greene has clashed with GOP leadership and was stripped of her committee assignments early in her congressional career. While she has not been formally “frozen out” of Trump’s circle, there are reports of tensions between her and other MAGA figures, and she is clearly using Epstein’s victims as a way to grab relevance and attention.
It should be a given that the victims get their day and as many times that they want to tell all the horrors and hold all of those found guilty of committing these horrendous acts accountable under the law, no matter who they are or what affiliation they have. The victims must not be used as political pawns.
